acceptance_criteria: A stable logical send identity reaches every Twilio provider invocation without being replaced on queue retry.
A deterministic failure before provider invocation remains retryable or definitive according to typed policy and records zero provider calls.
A failure after provider invocation is represented as ambiguous and is not blindly retried without proven idempotency.
A slow provider acceptance followed by client timeout produces at most one customer-visible SMS in the supported contract.
Chat, agent, durable replay, restart, and recovery tests prove the same phase and identity semantics.
Health, logs, and durable rows expose bounded phase and disposition fields without message content, destination identity, or raw exception prose.
blast_radius: Twilio chat and agent sends, durable outbound retries, recovery classification, customer SMS billing, duplicate delivery, and operator diagnostics.

A network-level send failure is deliberately mapped to retryable TransientProviderError even though the adapter notes that provider acceptance is ambiguous. Every decisive path is byte-equal between the pin and audit branch. falsifier_or_remaining_gap: The finding would be falsified by a provider-supported idempotency key threaded from the stable logical message ID, or by a post-provider-call ambiguity disposition that prevents blind retry. Exact-main source has neither. A slow accepted request followed by client timeout remains the decisive implementation-time fault injection.
impact: A Twilio request accepted before a client-side network failure can be sent again under a new provider request, delivering duplicate SMS while the durable queue believes it is performing a safe retry.
lead_verification_obligations: Re-read issue #2553 and remote main immediately before integration; reject changed state, node ID, title, labels, update time, URL, or body hash.

Prove Twilio's supported idempotency semantics from provider documentation before treating any request field as a duplicate-suppression boundary.
Add RED and GREEN slow-acceptance, timeout, pre-call failure, retry, restart, and recovery tests on committed implementation bytes.

suggested_remediation: Thread a stable logical-send identity through the bridge, adapter, port, and provider when Twilio supports a proven idempotency boundary. Otherwise distinguish failures before provider invocation from failures after invocation, record post-call uncertainty as maybe-sent ambiguity, suppress blind retry, and reconcile using bounded provider receipt evidence.
title: reliability(transport): ambiguous Twilio sends are retried without an idempotency boundary
